ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited (ACGL) Share Buyback**  Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited (ACGL) is initiating a tender offer buyback for up to 144,639 equity shares at ₹2,005 each, totaling approximately ₹29 Crores. This represents 2.38% of its total shares and 9.39% of its capital and free reserves, signifying a structured return of capital designed to enhance shareholder value through reduced outstanding shares. The process, with an opening date of November 3, 2026, and closing date of November 9, 2026, appears standard and regulation-compliant, with no immediate red flags identified regarding its scale or execution.
